report.answer_text: Jim proposes to Pam in “Weight Loss,” the Season 5 premiere of *The Office*, which originally aired on September 25, 2008. He proposes in the rain at a gas station. If your streaming service splits the premiere into two parts, the scene is in Part 2 (Season 5, Episode 2). (en.wikipedia.org)
